# AI NETRA â€” GEO workstream

**AI NETRA:** Next-Gen Emergency Triage & Rescue Assistant.  
**Pilot:** Moosarambagh / Musi River corridor, Hyderabad.  
**Purpose:** Evidence-backed geographic building intelligence for a flood-rescue prototype.

## Implemented capability
- Exact and nearby building polygon queries using Shapely STRtree.
- Model-estimated building heights (Google Open Buildings 2.5D, 2023).
- Approximate OSM-derived building footprint areas.
- Building-to-mapped-Musi-water-polygon distances.
- Building-to-nearest-TGRAC-waterlogging-point distances.
- Interactive Next.js / Leaflet map, government point markers and dropdown navigation.
- Source provenance and missing-data indicators.

## Start locally (three separate Windows CMD terminals)

Building API â€” port **8000**:

```cmd

.venv\Scripts\activate.bat
python -m uvicorn api:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
```

Waterlogging API â€” port **8001**:

```cmd

.venv\Scripts\activate.bat
python -m uvicorn waterlogging_api:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001
```

Frontend â€” port **3000**:

```cmd
cd frontend
npm run dev
```

Open http://localhost:3000. Stop duplicate Next.js servers rather than starting a second one.

## Documentation
Read `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `DATA_PIPELINE.md`, `DATA_SOURCES.md`, `API_REFERENCE.md`, `FILE_INVENTORY.md`, and `KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md` before changing the implementation.
